lesson_ratings.title: The Apateu Chant
lesson_ratings.reason: Only contains the non-English word 'apateu' and filler interjections; no real English vocabulary to learn.

lesson_ratings.title: Kissy Face and Red Hearts
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces several real English phrases and vocabulary like 'kissy face', 'sent to your phone', and 'come give me something I can feel'.

lesson_ratings.title: Don't You Want Me?
lesson_ratings.reason: Full of meaningful English sentences and structures, including questions and imperatives, ideal for learning.

lesson_ratings.title: Meet Me at the Apateu
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact reprise of the first lesson's chant with no new English content.

lesson_ratings.title: Turn This Apateu Into a Club
lesson_ratings.reason: Contains useful English vocabulary like 'drink, dance, smoke, freak, party' and phrases like 'it's whatever you like'.

lesson_ratings.title: Don't You Want Me? (Reprise)
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact repetition of lesson 3, adding no new learning value.

lesson_ratings.title: Meet Me at the Apateu (Reprise)
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact repetition of the chant from lessons 1 and 4, no new English words.

lesson_ratings.title: The Game (Part 1)
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces some real phrases like 'know the game', 'are you ready', and 'I'm on my way', but includes filler 'yeah'.

lesson_ratings.title: The Game (Part 2)
lesson_ratings.reason: Mostly repeats 'I'm on my way' and 'hold on' from Part 1 with many filler 'yeah's; very limited new content.

lesson_ratings.title: Don't You Want Me? (Final)
lesson_ratings.reason: Another reprise of the same chorus from lesson 3, no new material.

lesson_ratings.title: Outro: Just Meet Me at the Apateu (Part 1)
lesson_ratings.reason: Repeats the non-English chant and the already-learned phrase 'just meet me at the'.

lesson_ratings.title: Outro: Just Meet Me at the Apateu (Part 2)
lesson_ratings.reason: Same as Part 1, only the chant and the previously introduced phrase.

lesson_ratings.title: Outro: Just Meet Me at the Apateu (Part 3)
lesson_ratings.reason: Only the chant and filler interjections, no new English words.
